title: Sync retry templates, streaming backpressure hints, and cross-SDK release bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Nina Park
release_notes: Python SDK 1.12.0, TypeScript SDK 1.28.0, Go SDK v1.9.0: introduce curated retry-template presets, expose streaming backpressure hints, add cancel-safe iterator close semantics, unify credential telemetry tags; minor bugfixes and docs; see migration notes.
description: Motivation: Customers using long-lived streaming connections reported uneven retry behaviour and poor backpressure signals when consumers exercised slow sinks or transient auth refreshes. This PR delivers a coordinated change across the three official SDKs to (1) add a small, opinionated set of retry template presets (fast/fallback/hedged) usable out of the box, (2) expose a lightweight 'streamBackpressureHint' on streaming request shapes so servers and proxies can make informed batching/drop decisions, (3) ensure iterator/stream handles support a cancel-safe Close/Finish semantics so KV caches and background heartbeats shut down deterministically, and (4) align credential telemetry tags emitted by SDKs for easier cross-service tracing. Scope: cross-repo edits live in the monorepo under redwood-sdk-python/, redwood-sdk-typescript/, and redwood-sdk-go/; also includes docs and migration guide. Testing: added unit tests for retry-presets and backpressure hint propagation in each SDK, added an integration streaming smoke test that exercises slow consumer scenarios, and updated changelogs. Checklist: [x] add retry template DSL and presets in each SDK; [x] surface streamBackpressureHint in request builders; [x] implement Close/Finish idempotent semantics on stream iterators; [x] harmonize telemetry tags for credential operations; [x] tests and changelogs updated; [x] bump SDK package versions and release notes. Migration notes: users upgrading should switch to the new RetryTemplate presets or map their current RetryPolicy to one of the presets; the new streamBackpressureHint is optional and defaults to "none" for backward compatibility. Backwards-incompatible changes: none expected; if teams rely on implicit Close semantics they should opt into explicit Close/Finish to avoid relying on finalizers.

review_comments: Jonah Ellis: The retry presets look reasonable but please add a short doc blurb explaining the tradeoffs between 'fallback' and 'hedged' in the README; also please add a template for custom policy mapping.
Nina Park (author): addressed in docs and added mapping example; moved the hedged preset to use a slightly higher initial delay to avoid immediate duplicate traffic.
Priya Kapoor: In TS, the streamBackpressureHint felt tightly coupled to internal transport envelope; can you make it a lightweight shape-only field so other transports can ignore it?
Nina Park (author): changed TS surface to be transport-agnostic and added tests demonstrating how to noop the hint in a custom transport.
Marco Li: Go integration test failed with race on first run; looks like the iterator Close needed an extra edge-case for double-close. Please add idempotency guard.
Marco Li (author): added atomic guard and new test; re-ran CI and flakiness resolved.

internal_notes: We intentionally kept streamBackpressureHint as an opt-in, transport-agnostic hint to avoid breaking proxies that don't understand it. Observability alignment required a small change to credential event names (token_refresh -> cred.refresh) so downstream tracing dashboards will need updating; ENG-1187 tracks dashboard tweaks.
